method: Same-source joint bank/mip configuration ablation, not a historical-renderer before/after claim. Reference uses stable production order with one bank and full original mips; it skips residentMip SVD, favoring reference CPU cost. Candidate uses up to eight banks and conservative native original-mip residency. Variant setup precedes prepare/first draw; resource metadata is collected only by untimed counter calls. Canonical 100 visible units (footman/lancer/archer/priest), matching visible release/hit facts, hidden populations 0/9900, 2 independent WorldPresentation lifetimes per population. Preparation performs 18 real draws at n=0..51 then 60 CPU warmup frames; this does not prewarm every later pose. 360 paced=true measured CPU frames from n=114, one fresh snapshot per three frames. CPU samples disable renderer.render only: rasterization, texture transfers and possible driver backpressure remain. 18 real three-pass frames begin at n=480; with mixed cpuFrames=60, this deliberately preserves the original fixture's n=173->480 pose-streaming jump (~5.1 seconds), including its first cold-stream sample. Full presentation and nested World3DLayer costs are not additive. Real complete wall includes Canvas work, GPU fence completion and event-loop scheduling, not GPU timer-query duration or hardware FPS. Camera blank/return images and same-source facts are verified strictly. Snapshot construction, simulation, capture and GC are outside measured draws.
